description: This file defines the 'tlRole' class, representing user roles within the TestLink project. It includes properties and methods for managing roles, such as creating, reading, updating, deleting roles, checking rights, and retrieving associated users.

classes.name: tlRole
classes.description: Represents user roles in the system, providing methods to manage role properties, rights, and associated users, including database interactions for persistence.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new tlRole object, optionally loading data by database ID.

methods.name: _clean
methods.description: Resets the role's description, rights, name, and database ID based on specified options.

methods.name: copyFromCache
methods.description: Copies role data from another tlRole object.

methods.name: readFromDB
methods.description: Loads role data from the database, optionally fetching full details.

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Saves the role, including rights, to the database.

methods.name: checkDetails
methods.description: Validates the role's details before database operations.

methods.name: doesRoleExist
methods.description: Checks if a role with the given name exists in the database.

methods.name: checkRoleName
methods.description: Validates the role name for length and emptiness.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a display-friendly version of the role's name.

methods.name: deleteFromDB
methods.description: Deletes the role from the database.

methods.name: replaceUserRolesWith
methods.description: Replaces users' roles with a new role, used when deleting a role.

methods.name: getUsersWithGlobalRole
methods.description: Retrieves users with this global role.

methods.name: getUserIDsWithGlobalRole
methods.description: Returns IDs of users with this global role.

methods.name: getUserIDsWithTestProjectRole
methods.description: Returns IDs of users with a specific test project role.

methods.name: getUserIDsWithTestPlanRole
methods.description: Returns IDs of users with a specific test plan role.

methods.name: getUsersWithTestProjectRole
methods.description: Retrieves users with a specific test project role.

methods.name: getUsersWithTestPlanRole
methods.description: Retrieves users with a specific test plan role.

methods.name: getAllUsersWithRole
methods.description: Retrieves all users with any role associated with this role.

methods.name: hasRight
methods.description: Checks if the role has a specific right.

methods.name: deleteRightsFromDB
methods.description: Removes all rights associated with this role from the database.

methods.name: addRightsToDB
methods.description: Associates rights with this role in the database.

methods.name: readRights
methods.description: Loads rights associated with the role from the database.

methods.name: buildRightsArray
methods.description: Constructs an array of rights from database info.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Retrieves a role object by its ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all roles from the database, with optional filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getByIDs
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended to retrieve multiple roles by their IDs.

methods.name: getRoleColourCfg
methods.description: Returns a mapping of roles to colors based on system configuration.
